g.text: # 5 min 50 s of waiting, cut
The design is finished and waiting for your approval. I'm done with the tool steps.
Office Lunch Catering (proposal prop-3a9db893bf) has 8 departments and 16 roles:
- Executive: CEO and Chief of Staff.
- Menu: Head of Merchandising, Menu Planner, and a Food Safety and Allergen Reviewer.
- Corporate Sales: Head of Corporate Accounts and a Proposal Writer.
- Operations: COO, a Kitchen and Procurement Planner, and a Delivery Scheduler.
- Customer Care: one head.
- Finance: a Finance and Billing Lead, covering pricing, invoices and payment reminders.
- Quality Assurance: QA Lead and Reviewer.
- Legal and Compliance: General Counsel and Compliance Reviewer.
Cost: about 104,000–222,000 tokens per typical run. The top of that range could hit the 200,000-token ceiling,
which stops the run and asks you.
… (shortened)
Skill discovery also stopped at its limit, so some needs weren't searched. You can request skills at the issue
link in the review.
Template leftovers: Merchandising and Customer Care came from the e-commerce template, so a few mission lines
still say "store" and "shoppers". I couldn't change those in this design.
Next step: you approve it at a terminal with trypro init --review prop-3a9db893bf. I can't do that step.

g.text: vegetarian main. Keep it to two sentences.
# 1 min 6 s of waiting, cut
The run is done, and the company drafted your reply. QA and Legal both approved it with no issues.
> Yes, we do cover vegetarian meals. Every day's menu includes a vegetarian main.
It's two sentences and states only the two facts you gave. It makes no claims about vegan options, allergens or
pricing. known_limits came back empty.
The deliverable is at <folder>/deliverables/run-09a942a85934/index.md.

main. Keep it to two sentences.
